01 Executive Summary: Ye Web App Kya Kaam Karta Hai?

NeuralEye 3D Vision ek cutting-edge, industrial-grade Computer Vision aur Deep Learning Web Platform hai. Yeh application high-resolution video streams, live optical cameras, aur static drone/panoramic images ko real-time me analyze karke multi-class objects (Cars, Bikes, Persons, Buses, Traffic Lights, Animals, Gadgets) ko detect karti hai aur unke upar precise 3D Depth Bounding Projections draw karti hai.

Traditional AI applications me aapka video stream kisi third-party cloud server par bheja jata hai jahan latency aati hai aur data leak hone ka khatra hota hai. NeuralEye is paradigm ko transform karta hai: yeh model ko sidha user ke browser me WebAssembly (WASM SIMD) aur WebWorkers ke through execute karta hai, jisse 0.0ms Cloud Latency aur 100% On-Device Privacy milti hai.

⚡ Real-Time In-Browser Edge Inference

YOLOv11 deep neural network sidha client ke CPU/GPU par execute hota hai bina frame cloud par bheje.

🎯 SAHI Micro-Window Slicing

Ultra-high-definition 4K images ko micro-crops me slice karke minute aur distant objects accurately detect karta hai.

🛡️ 100% Air-Gapped Privacy

GDPR aur military standards ke mutabiq zero video egress — sensitive surveillance video device memory me hi rehta hai.

📊 Live Telemetry & Class Breakdown

Real-time analytics engine jo scene objects, distribution donut chart, aur instant class inventory count provide karta hai.

02 Kyun Banaya Gaya? (Problem Statement & Purpose)

Pehle ke surveillance aur smart vision systems me 4 badi samasyaayein (bottlenecks) thi, jinko solve karne ke liye NeuralEye ko design kiya gaya:

Traditional Cloud AI Problem Industry Impact NeuralEye Edge Solution
High Cloud Latency CCTV feed ko cloud server bhejna aur wapas response aana 300ms-800ms leta hai, jo autonomous navigation aur live security ke liye slow hai. 0.0ms Network Latency — WASM SIMD ke saath browser/device memory me local inference.
Severe Privacy Risks Sensitive public cameras ya private offices ki video feed external servers par transfer hone se data breach aur surveillance leaks hote hain. Air-Gapped Sandbox — Video frames device se bahar travel hi nahi karte. 100% on-premise.
Exorbitant GPU Cloud Costs 24/7 chalne wale hazaron cameras ke liye AWS/GCP par A100 GPU servers rent karna monthly lakho rupaye ka kharcha hota hai. Zero Infrastructure Cost — Client device hardware compute use karta hai. Unlimited scalability.
Small & Occluded Objects Loss Standard 640x640 resize me 4K drones ya wide-angle traffic feeds me door khade log aur chhote vehicles gayab ho jaate hain. SAHI Slicing Engine — Multi-scale patch processing jo 10x door ke objects detect karta hai.

🚦 Smart Cities & Traffic

Intersection congestion monitoring, vehicle counting (Cars, Buses, Bikes), pedestrian crossing safety, red-light telemetry tracking.

🏭 Industrial & Factories

High-altitude UAV reconnaissance, disaster relief victim spotting, border security patrolling, crop health monitoring.

04 Kaise Use Karein? (Step-by-Step Operator Guide)
1
Interactive Dashboard Launch (/dashboard)

Web browser me project open karein. Top navigation bar se Dashboard select karein. Platform automatic client WASM SIMD environment load karta hai.

2
Input Mode Selection (Image vs. Live Webcam)

Choose Image par click karke apni custom 4K image upload karein ya built-in benchmark samples (Live Intersection, Traffic Scene, Car, Objects) par click karein.

3
Target Architecture & Confidence Tuning

Detection sensitivity ke liye Conf Slider (0.10 - 0.95) set karein. Model architecture dropdown se Smart Desk & Gadgets, COCO 80, ya YOLO-World Zero-Shot chun sakte hain.

4
Live Camera Feed & HUD Telemetry (/live)

Full viewport live camera tracking ke liye Live View tab par jayein aur Start Camera Feed click karein. Local webcam frames real-time 3D bounding boxes ke saath annotate hote hain.

5
Real-Time Telemetry & Inventory Breakdown

Left panel par Telemetry Inferred / min, Object Distribution Donut, aur Class Breakdown (Cars: 2, Bus: 1...) automatically compute hota hai.

05 Technical Architecture: Kaise Bani Hai?
Layer Technologies Architectural Responsibility
Client Frontend React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion Ultra-fast reactive UI, Cyberpunk HUD reticles, interactive analytics canvas, high-DPI scaling.
Edge Inference ONNX Runtime Web, WASM SIMD, WebWorkers Non-blocking multi-threaded inference on client browser; zero frame uploads to remote cloud.
Backend Microservice Python FastAPI, PyTorch, Ultralytics YOLOv11 High-accuracy batch processing, heavy tensor operations, REST and WebSocket endpoints.
Slicing Engine SAHI (Slicing Aided Hyper Inference), OpenCV Gigapixel image slicing, overlapping window inference, and Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) merging.
